notes:
Mercedes-Benz E-Class, chassis 211 (W211 saloon, S211 estate).

The diagnostic socket's CAN pair (pins 6 and 14) reaches the central gateway at 500 kbit/s. Control units answer KWP2000 requests carried over ISO 15765-2.

The address table is transcribed from an open E55 AMG project that states no model year. Treat every row as unconfirmed on a given car until `obd-read probe` shows the unit answering.

0x92 is the session W211 instrument-cluster code opens before reading data.
name: mercedes-w211

vin.source: The WMIs are the Mercedes-Benz car and SUV identifiers in the world manufacturer identifier table of the Wikipedia article Vehicle identification number, which cites the Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt manufacturer list SV 3.2 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_identification_number, archived https://web.archive.org/web/20261102120229/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_identification_number). Characters 4 to 6 of a Mercedes-Benz VIN in the rest-of-world form are the model series, as the Niemoeller VIN guide states with a W169 example (https://www.niemoeller.de/en/mercedes-benz-oldtimer-spare-parts/vin, archived https://web.archive.org/web/20261116163107/https://www.niemoeller.de/en/mercedes-benz-oldtimer-spare-parts/vin); a North American VIN codes the model with letters instead, so it matches none of these models.
